title: Tight Spin Dribble Cones
description: Players spin around cones placed close together, learning to pull the ball tight to the hip so a defender cannot reach it during the turn.

content.objective: Execute a tight spin dribble that keeps the ball close to the body and the eyes up through the turn.
content.setup: Four cones in a diagonal line from the wing to the block, two metres apart.
content.organization: One line at the wing; go when the player ahead reaches the third cone.
instructions: Drive at the first cone with the right hand.
Plant the left foot beside the cone and spin backwards, pulling the ball tight around the hip.
Switch the ball to the left hand as you come out of the spin.
Attack the next cone and spin the other way.
After the last cone, finish at the rim.
coachingPoints: Pull the ball, do not swing it: it stays on the hip through the spin.
Plant foot close to the cone so the spin is tight.
Snap the head round first to see the floor.
commonMistakes: Wide spin that takes the ball away from the body.
Carrying the ball with the palm under it.
Losing sight of the rim during the spin.
content.safety: Cones low and flat; players finish away from the next player's path.
progressions: Add a defender beside each cone who swipes at the ball.
Spin, then pull up for a jump shot.
regressions: Walk through the footwork without the ball.
Two cones only, with more space.
variations: Reverse the course from the baseline outward.
Use a half-spin and come back the same way.
successCriteria: Ball stays below the hip and close to the body in every spin.
content.gameApplication: A tight spin beats a defender who has cut off the drive and is leaning to the ball.
